items.q: reopen the Ambassadors, for Mr. Fischer. Latiege & Fischer, who had it before with Mr. Sayag. They had decided to take over, Latiege & Fischer, the booking office.

ctx.x: Yes, after the war, we organized an orchestra. We had a proposition for Chez Florence, which I appreciated, 'cause many of my friends, tried to get the same proposition, which was about the best thing that was offered for the time being.

Noble Sissle came back to Paris, in a U.S.O. show, and he tried to get me to reform his orchestra for him, in Paris, to reopen the Ambassadors, for Mr. Fischer. Latiege & Fischer, who had it before with Mr. Sayag. They had decided to take over, Latiege & Fischer, the booking office.
